capabilities: Assign colored categories to folders and files via the context menu
Style categories with markers, icons, backgrounds, bold or dim text
Propagate a category's appearance to subfolders and files through inheritance switches
Group categories into legends shown as tabs and context-menu submenus
Manage categories in a draft window with JSON backup and restore
disambiguation: Not a tagging or metadata system; categories exist only to change how the file explorer looks.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.12.0 or newer; works on desktop and mobile. The README states the plugin makes no network requests and stores settings only in data.json.
intentEvidence: It writes a single <style> element into the document head and lets Obsidian do the drawing
problem: Obsidian's file explorer offers no built-in way to visually group folders and files by category without coloring each item one by one.

relations.evidence: The Folder notes plugin opens the note that lives inside the folder, and if the file explorer

summary: File-explorer addon that assigns colored categories to folders and files, with markers, icons, inheritance and grouped legends.
